_comment: Single source of truth for coverage floors and code-metric ceilings. Read by jest.config.js, the CI coverage check and the PR report renderer, so a number changes in one place. Floors sit a few points below current values: enough slack for changes that legitimately add uncovered lines, tight enough that a real regression fails. The PR report shows the delta against the base branch, so a fractional dip is visible to a reviewer without failing the build.

metrics._comment: Only metrics listed in max are reported in the PR comment. Every one is a ceiling, so worse always means higher. Keys in gate fail CI; the rest annotate the comment.
